Contributors: Ligowsky, A., cartographer, surveyor; S. & R.S. Taintor Jr. & Co., publisher

County cadastral wall map showing towns (townships), town survey divisions (some numbered), irregular rural property tracts, rural buildings, and rural householders' names; also shows individual buildings and occupants' names in the village insets.

County cadastral wall map showing towns (townships), town survey divisions (some numbered), irregular rural property tracts, rural buildings, and rural householders' names; also shows individual buildings and occupants' names in the village insets. Hand colored (watercolor) to emphasize town boundaries. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1857 by Robert Pearsall Smith in [...] the Eastern District of Pennsylvania." Originally printed on 3 sheets (later conjoined to form 2 sheets [northern/southern] on cloth backing). LC sheets imperfect: Fold-lined, trimmed at sheet edges, sectioned to 2 sheets each folding to vertical panels. Includes local business directories, 21 village insets (including Lowville), and illustrations of prominent buildings/residences/waterfalls.
